$description: Shared generation rules for Control DNA. These rules define how control components should feel like one family.
principles: Prefer one coherent family over one-off component optimizations.
Resolve from gene -> rule -> style block -> Figma binding.
Use Button as the golden reference for interaction and visual rhythm, but do not force Button-only anatomy onto every control.

familyTraits.shapeLanguage: Rounded corners with small/large scale progression and optional full-round override.
familyTraits.interactionLanguage: Hover and active states shift semantic color, disabled collapses into shared neutral treatment, focus mirrors hover unless a component adds activeShadow.
familyTraits.spacingLanguage: Compact horizontal rhythm with predictable icon-text gap and size-dependent padding.
familyTraits.typographyLanguage: Shared text styles by size tier; large size steps up both font size and line height.

notes: Size is the primary geometry driver for controls.
If a control has no size axis, it must declare sizeStrategy=fixed in its component spec.
Variants choose a visual strategy such as solid, outline, ghost, text, or link.
Palette should stay semantic. Do not encode raw color values in variant definitions.
State changes should read as the same interaction language across the family.
Disabled always resolves through the shared neutral token set unless the component spec documents an exception.

tokenRefs: inherits hover state tokens by default
no dedicated loading token set in Control DNA v1
notes: Loading should disable click or equivalent interaction.
Loading appearance may inherit hover tokens when no dedicated loading palette exists.

resolutionOrder: Start from the component's declared DNA and inherited genes.
Resolve variant into an appearance strategy and semantic palette.
Apply state tokens on top of the chosen variant.
Apply modifiers such as danger, ghost, status, icon, and loading.
Bind the resolved output to Figma layers and component properties.

figmaBindings: label or field fills -> text token
icon vector fills -> mirror text token unless overridden

componentGenerationChecklist: Classify the new component under Control DNA in _dna-tree.json.
Declare only the variant axes the component truly exposes.
Reuse shared genes before adding component-only constants.
Document every hardcoded value in mappingCoverage.gaps or mapped:false fields.
Verify the resulting Figma set still looks like Button's family in rhythm, state behavior, and token usage.
